charts.title: TOI-2285 b: orbits around TOI-2285
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-2285's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-2285 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Fukui 2025 (2025RNAAS...9...73F), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname FUKUI_2025): P 13.635109 d

charts.title: TOI-2285 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-2285 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (77, 83, 84) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 329148988, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 20 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 21 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 20 min early; 10-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 7 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
